text_en: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, with the elders of Judah sitting before me, the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.
text_cn: 六年六月五日，当我坐在我屋内，犹大的长老们坐在我面前时，吾主上主的手临于我。

text_en: I looked, and there was a figure that looked like a human being; below what appeared to be its loins it was fire, and above the loins it was like the appearance of brightness, like gleaming amber.
text_cn: 我观望，看，有一个形像，形状如人，在他相似腰部的下面，有一团火，在他腰部的上面好像有一道光辉，像发亮的金属。

text_en: It stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north, to the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
text_cn: 他伸出一只像手的形状，抓住我的一绺(liǔ)头发，有一种神力把我提到天地之间，在神视中将我提往耶路撒冷去，到了内门的北门门口，在那里供奉着引起上主妒火的偶像。

text_en: And the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision that I had seen in the valley.
text_cn: 在那里出现了以色列天主的光荣，相似我在平原所见的异像。

text_en: Then God said to me, “O mortal, lift up your eyes now in the direction of the north. ” So I lifted up my eyes toward the north, and there, north of the altar gate, in the entrance, was this image of jealousy.
text_cn: 他向我说：“人子，举目向北方看！”我遂举目向北方看；看见在靠近祭坛的北门门口，有那引起上主妒火的偶像。

text_en: He said to me, “Mortal, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel are committing here, to drive me far from my sanctuary? Yet you will see still greater abominations. ”
text_cn: 他又向我说：“人子，你看他们作的是什么？以色列家族在这里所行的极其丑恶之事，使我非离开我的圣所不可，但你还要看见更为丑恶的事。”

text_en: And he brought me to the entrance of the court; I looked, and there was a hole in the wall.
text_cn: 以后，他引我到外院的大门口，我看见在墙上有一个洞。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Mortal, dig through the wall”; and when I dug through the wall, there was an entrance.
text_cn: 他向我说：“人子，把这墙穿一个洞！”我遂在墙上穿了一个洞，出现了一道门。

text_en: He said to me, “Go in, and see the vile abominations that they are committing here. ”
text_cn: 他又向我说：“你进去看一看他们在那里所做的穷凶极恶的丑行。”

text_en: So I went in and looked; there, portrayed on the wall all around, were all kinds of creeping things, and loathsome animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel.
text_cn: 我便进去，看见有各种爬虫和走兽的像，都是可憎恶的；还有以色列家的各种偶像，都刻画在四周的墙上。

text_en: Before them stood seventy of the elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had his censer in his hand, and the fragrant cloud of incense was ascending.
text_cn: 以色列家族的七十长老， 沙番的儿子雅匝尼雅也在他们中间，都站在那些像前，每人手中拿着香炉，烧的香烟如浓云，正在上腾。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Mortal, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each in his room of images? For they say, ‘The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land. ’”
text_cn: 他对我说：“人子，你看见了以色列的长老在黑暗中，每人在藏神像的暗室中所行的事吗？他们说：上主看不见我们，上主已离弃了此地。”

text_en: He said also to me, “You will see still greater abominations that they are committing. ”
text_cn: 他又向我说：“你还要看见他们所行的更丑恶的事。”

text_en: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord ; women were sitting there weeping for Tammuz.
text_cn: 以后，他引我到了上主的圣殿朝北的大门口。看，有些妇女坐在那里，哀悼塔慕次。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, O mortal? You will see still greater abominations than these. ”
text_cn: 他向我说：“人子，你看见了吗？但你还要看见比这更丑恶的事。”

text_en: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord ; there, at the entrance of the temple of the Lord , between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with their backs to the temple of the Lord , and their faces toward the east, prostrating themselves to the sun toward the east.
text_cn: 以后，他引我到了上主圣殿的内庭院内；看，在上主圣所的门口，在走廊和祭坛中间约有二十五个人，背向上主的圣所，面向东方，他们正在向东方朝拜太阳。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, O mortal? Is it not bad enough that the house of Judah commits the abominations done here? Must they fill the land with violence, and provoke my anger still further? See, they are putting the branch to their nose!
text_cn: 他又向我说：“人子，你看见了吗？在这里行的这些丑恶之事，为犹大家还不够吗？他们还将此地充满了残暴之事，时时惹我忿怒。看，他们还把枝条举到自己鼻子上。

text_en: Therefore I will act in wrath; my eye will not spare, nor will I have pity; and though they cry in my hearing with a loud voice, I will not listen to them. ”
text_cn: 我必大发愤怒，我的眼决不怜视，一点也不顾惜；即使他们在我耳旁高声喊叫，我仍不俯听他们。”
